text:
Orbiton Systems has leased the Brevik ground station from Northfjord Infrastructure in a five-year deal worth 18.4 million krona, according to documents filed Thursday. The satellite operator will use the site, outside Tromvik, to expand telemetry and downlink capacity for its low-Earth-orbit fleet. Orbiton said the station’s upgraded 9.2-meter antenna and fiber backhaul will be live by early Q2, supporting up to 14 additional passes a day.

The lease gives Orbiton a northern-Europe footprint without building a new facility, cutting setup time by months, executives said. For the sector, the move underscores how operators are increasingly renting ground assets to speed capacity growth and control capital spending.
